strings.zh: 你好啊,路过的训练家。{NEWLINE}传说湛蓝市东边的旋涡列岛{CLEAR}栖息着海神洛奇亚。{CLEAR}我们湛蓝市的居民{CLEAR}为了感谢洛奇亚守护大海、{CLEAR}表达对洛奇亚的敬意,{CLEAR}于是举办了旋涡列岛挑战赛。{SCROLL}只要你能周游旋涡列岛,{NEWLINE}到每座岛上去叙说洛奇亚的故事、{CLEAR}展现人与精灵的羁绊,{CLEAR}就能赢得挑战奖品。{CLEAR}请问你要试试看吗？
strings.en: Hello there, passing Trainer. Legend{NEWLINE}says Lugia, god of the sea, lives in the{CLEAR}Whirl Islands east of Cianwood City.{SCROLL}We folks of Cianwood hold{NEWLINE}the Whirl Islands Challenge{CLEAR}to thank Lugia for guarding the{CLEAR}sea and to show it our respect.{SCROLL}Just travel around the Whirl Islands,{NEWLINE}tell Lugia’s story on each island{CLEAR}and show the bond between people{CLEAR}and Pokémon, and you’ll win a prize.{SCROLL}Would you like to give it a try?

strings.en: The Whirl Islands Challenge will{NEWLINE}run for a while yet. If you want to{CLEAR}take part, come see me anytime.

strings.en: You’re very welcome to take part! Let{NEWLINE}me explain how the challenge works.{SCROLL}You need to visit the four{NEWLINE}islands of the Whirl Islands and{CLEAR}face the Trainer on each one{CLEAR}in a quiz and a Pokémon battle.{SCROLL}Then come back here and{NEWLINE}report to me, and I’ll give you{CLEAR}a prize based on your results.{SCROLL}Your Whirl Islands Challenge{NEWLINE}starts now. Take your{CLEAR}Pokémon and head out to sea!

strings.zh: 据说每年6月份的雨{NEWLINE}就是海神洛奇亚扇动翅膀带来的,{CLEAR}所以湛蓝市有个风俗{CLEAR}就是六月下雨出门不打伞。{SCROLL}这里的人们用自己的身体{NEWLINE}接受海神大人带来的风雨,{CLEAR}以此来祈祷海神大人保佑{CLEAR}第二年风调雨顺、作物丰收。

strings.zh: 米那君『有两下子嘛水君,{NEWLINE}不过你能抗住耿鬼的攻击{CLEAR}也在意料之中。{CLEAR}换你上了顽皮弹！
strings.en: Eusine: Not bad, Suicune. Though I{NEWLINE}expected you to withstand Gengar’s{CLEAR}attack. You’re up next, Electrode!

strings.zh: 米那君『顽皮弹,使用电磁波！

strings.zh: 顽皮弹『Elee……
strings.en: Electrode: Elee...

strings.zh: 米那君『谢谢你,顽皮弹！

strings.zh: 米那君『胡地,就决定是你了！

strings.zh: 胡地『Alaa——ka！
strings.en: Alakazam: Alaa-ka!

strings.zh: 水君『Suiii……

strings.zh: 米那君『哦？想通过睡觉{NEWLINE}恢复体力和状态？{CLEAR}这正是攻击的好机会,上啊胡地！
strings.en: Eusine: Oh? Trying to sleep to restore{NEWLINE}your strength and condition? Now’s{CLEAR}our chance to attack. Go, Alakazam!

strings.zh: 米那君『胡地！！！{SCROLL}米那君『怎么会这样,{NEWLINE}水君明明睡着了……
strings.en: Eusine: Alakazam!!!{SCROLL}Eusine: How can this be?{NEWLINE}Suicune was fast asleep...

strings.zh: 米那君『原来如此,{NEWLINE}水君你是用梦话进行了攻击。{SCROLL}米那君『了不起啊！{NEWLINE}我用出了三只最强的精灵{CLEAR}都没有拼出一个收服你的机会,{CLEAR}真不愧是我苦苦追寻了这么久的精灵,{CLEAR}我越来越喜欢你了！
strings.en: Eusine: I see. Suicune, you{NEWLINE}attacked with Sleep Talk.{SCROLL}Eusine: Magnificent! I{NEWLINE}sent out my three strongest{CLEAR}Pokémon and still couldn’t win{CLEAR}a single chance to catch you.{SCROLL}You truly are the Pokémon{NEWLINE}I’ve searched for so long.{CLEAR}I like you more and more!

strings.zh: 水晶『水君好厉害啊,{NEWLINE}没有训练家指挥都能这样灵活应对,{CLEAR}我也有点想试试收服水君了……{SCROLL}水晶『不过水君刚刚战斗完,{NEWLINE}现在出手的话有点趁人之危,{CLEAR}还是等下次有机会再说吧。
strings.en: Crystal: Suicune is amazing. It can{NEWLINE}react so smartly without a Trainer{CLEAR}giving orders. I kind of want{CLEAR}to try catching Suicune too...{SCROLL}Crystal: But Suicune just finished{NEWLINE}a battle. Making a move now would{CLEAR}be taking unfair advantage.{CLEAR}I’ll wait for another chance.

strings.zh: 小豪『我听到这边有战斗的声音……
strings.en: Goh: I heard a battle{NEWLINE}going on over here...

strings.zh: 小豪『哇哇哇哇哇,{NEWLINE}这不是传说中的精灵水君吗？{CLEAR}虽然不是我一直寻找的梦幻,{CLEAR}但能收服你的话也是挺有价值的。{SCROLL}小豪『上吧,精灵球,Go！
strings.en: Goh: Whoa whoa whoa whoa whoa! Isn’t{NEWLINE}that the legendary Pokémon Suicune?{CLEAR}It’s not the Mew I’ve been looking for,{CLEAR}but catching you would still be worth it.{SCROLL}Goh: Poké Ball, go!

strings.zh: 米那君『等一下！
strings.en: Eusine: Wait!

strings.zh: 小豪『喂,你干什么,{NEWLINE}别挡着我扔球啊,闪一边去。
strings.en: Goh: Hey, what do you think{NEWLINE}you’re doing? Don’t block my{CLEAR}throw. Get out of the way.

strings.zh: 米那君『我刚刚跟水君战斗完,{NEWLINE}它现在还有些疲惫,{CLEAR}你现在扔球收服,{CLEAR}是不是有点捡便宜呢？
strings.en: Eusine: I just finished battling{NEWLINE}Suicune, and it’s still a little{CLEAR}worn out. Isn’t throwing a Ball{CLEAR}at it now a bit of a cheap shot?

strings.zh: 小豪『你战斗完收服不了{NEWLINE}那是你无能,{CLEAR}现在我一球收服给你看。
strings.en: Goh: If you can’t catch{NEWLINE}it after battling it, that’s{CLEAR}because you’re useless. Now{CLEAR}watch me catch it with one Ball.

strings.zh: 米那君『水君是传说中的精灵,{NEWLINE}据说当它重现于世时,{CLEAR}是要寻找并肩作战的伙伴{CLEAR}与凤王一起战胜邪恶。{CLEAR}所以收服它之前{CLEAR}一定要获得它的认可{CLEAR}并与它心意相通。{CLEAR}你这样趁它疲惫扔球收服,{CLEAR}未免有点太不尊重传说中的精灵了。
strings.en: Eusine: Suicune is a legendary{NEWLINE}Pokémon. They say that when it{CLEAR}returns to the world, it seeks{CLEAR}a partner to fight alongside, to{CLEAR}defeat evil together with Ho-Oh.{SCROLL}So before you catch it, you{NEWLINE}must earn its approval and{CLEAR}become one in heart with it.{SCROLL}Throwing a Ball at it while{NEWLINE}it’s worn out shows far too little{CLEAR}respect for a legendary Pokémon.

strings.zh: 小豪『不过是只精灵而已,{NEWLINE}只要能被我装进球里{CLEAR}那就是合法合理的收服,{CLEAR}至于你说的那些,{CLEAR}纯粹就是无聊的自我感动。{CLEAR}赶紧给我让开！
strings.en: Goh: It’s just a Pokémon.{NEWLINE}As long as I get it in my Ball,{CLEAR}that’s a fair and legit catch.{SCROLL}All that stuff you’re spouting{NEWLINE}is just boring self-indulgent{CLEAR}drama. Now get out of my way!

strings.zh: 水晶『作为训练家{NEWLINE}对精灵的尊重是最基本的,{CLEAR}所以请你接受收服水君的仪式感,{CLEAR}等下次有机会再收服吧。
strings.en: Crystal: Respecting Pokémon is{NEWLINE}the most basic thing for a Trainer.{CLEAR}So please respect the proper{CLEAR}ceremony of catching Suicune{CLEAR}and wait for another chance.

strings.zh: 小豪『你们这些人真是爱多管闲事,{NEWLINE}我看你们就是自己抓不住水君,{CLEAR}所以也不想我出手去抓吧？{CLEAR}哼,真是小肚鸡肠的训练家,{CLEAR}给我闪一边去。
strings.en: Goh: You people are such busybodies.{NEWLINE}I bet you just can’t catch{CLEAR}Suicune yourselves, so you don’t{CLEAR}want me to catch it either, huh?{SCROLL}Hmph, what petty Trainers.{NEWLINE}Get out of my way.

strings.zh: 水晶『啊！你怎么还推人呢。
strings.en: Crystal: Ah! Why are{NEWLINE}you pushing people?!

strings.zh: 小豪『你在那嘟囔个不停,{NEWLINE}我都快被你烦死了。{CLEAR}现在我要收服水君,{CLEAR}你们再敢来碍事,{CLEAR}可就不是推你那么简单了。
strings.en: Goh: You won’t stop muttering.{NEWLINE}You’re driving me nuts.{SCROLL}I’m catching Suicune now. If{NEWLINE}you dare get in my way again,{CLEAR}it won’t just be a shove.

strings.zh: 要去阻止小豪吗？
strings.en: Stop Goh?
strings.notes: branch: Yes → player stops Goh (#89–#98); No → Crystal stops him (#100–#103).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『给我适可而止吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: That’s enough!

strings.zh: 小豪『哼,我早就看到你这个{NEWLINE}招人烦的家伙在旁边了,{CLEAR}这次你还是想来坏我的事是吧？
strings.en: Goh: Hmph, I saw you standing{NEWLINE}over there ages ago, you pain{CLEAR}in the neck. So you’re here to{CLEAR}ruin things for me again, huh?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我只是希望你能尊重一下{NEWLINE}捕捉水君的基本礼仪。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I just want you to show some{NEWLINE}basic respect when catching Suicune.

strings.zh: 小豪『每次破坏别人捕捉{NEWLINE}还要给自己一个大义凛然的借口,{CLEAR}我最受不了你们这种虚伪的人。{CLEAR}今天我非狠狠揍你一顿不可！
strings.en: Goh: Every time you wreck{NEWLINE}someone’s catch, you’ve got{CLEAR}some high-and-mighty excuse. I{CLEAR}can’t stand hypocrites like you.{SCROLL}Today I’m gonna give{NEWLINE}you a real beating!

strings.zh: 小豪『嘿嘿,你赢了我又怎么样,{NEWLINE}只要我现在扔一个曲线球出去……
strings.en: Goh: Heh heh, so what if you{NEWLINE}beat me? All I have to do{CLEAR}is throw a curveball now...

strings.zh: 小豪『喂！水君——！
strings.en: Goh: Hey! Suicune!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『水君看都没看你就走了,{NEWLINE}看来它并不认可你这个{CLEAR}自以为能成为它主人的人,{CLEAR}所以你还是放弃吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Suicune left without even{NEWLINE}looking at you. It doesn’t accept{CLEAR}you, even if you think you can{CLEAR}be its master. So just give up.

strings.zh: 小豪『我捕捉精灵{NEWLINE}从来不需要什么认可,{CLEAR}扔球就能成功。{CLEAR}下次再让我遇到水君,{CLEAR}它一定会成为我球里的精灵,{CLEAR}你们就等着瞧吧！
strings.en: Goh: I never need anyone’s{NEWLINE}approval to catch Pokémon. I{CLEAR}just throw a Ball and it works.{SCROLL}Next time I run into Suicune, it’ll be{NEWLINE}in my Ball for sure. Just you wait!

strings.zh: 米那君『{VAR:0103:0}啊,我是没想到{NEWLINE}还有这么厚脸皮的人想收服水君。{CLEAR}看来我不能有丝毫的放松,{CLEAR}必须要马上找到{CLEAR}水君的下一个落脚点才行。
strings.en: Eusine: {VAR:0103:0}, I never imagined{NEWLINE}anyone would be shameless enough{CLEAR}to try catching Suicune like that.{SCROLL}I can’t let my guard down for{NEWLINE}a moment. I must find where{CLEAR}Suicune goes next right away.

strings.zh: 米那君『水晶小姐,谢谢你刚才{NEWLINE}为保护水君仗义执言,{CLEAR}咱们有缘再见了。
strings.en: Eusine: Miss Crystal, thank you{NEWLINE}for speaking up to protect Suicune{CLEAR}just now. Until we meet again.

strings.zh: 水晶『米那君为了收服水君{NEWLINE}还真是执着呢……
strings.en: Crystal: Eusine sure is{NEWLINE}determined to catch Suicune...

strings.zh: 水晶『如果你再不住手,{NEWLINE}我可就要使用精灵阻止你了。
strings.en: Crystal: If you don’t stop, I’ll{NEWLINE}use my Pokémon to stop you.

strings.zh: 小豪『就凭你这破烂大竹葵？{NEWLINE}哼哼,有本事就来试试啊！
strings.en: Goh: With that junky Meganium of{NEWLINE}yours? Heh heh, go ahead and try!

strings.zh: 水晶『水君看都没看你就走了,{NEWLINE}看来它并不认可你这个{CLEAR}自以为能成为它主人的人,{CLEAR}所以你还是放弃吧。
strings.en: Crystal: Suicune left without even{NEWLINE}looking at you. It doesn’t accept{CLEAR}you, even if you think you can{CLEAR}be its master. So just give up.

strings.zh: 米那君『水晶小姐,我是没想到{NEWLINE}还有这么厚脸皮的人想收服水君。{CLEAR}看来我不能有丝毫的放松,{CLEAR}必须要马上找到{CLEAR}水君的下一个落脚点才行。{CLEAR}咱们有缘再见了。
strings.en: Eusine: Miss Crystal, I never imagined{NEWLINE}anyone would be shameless enough{CLEAR}to try catching Suicune like that.{SCROLL}I can’t let my guard down for a{NEWLINE}moment. I must find where Suicune goes{CLEAR}next right away. Until we meet again.

strings.zh: 米那君『很好,水君的行动{NEWLINE}已经不像刚才那么敏捷了。
strings.en: Eusine: Good. Suicune isn’t{NEWLINE}moving as nimbly as before.

strings.zh: 米那君『这是我最后的王牌了,{NEWLINE}接下来你会怎么办呢水君？
strings.en: Eusine: This is my last trump card.{NEWLINE}What will you do now, Suicune?

strings.zh: 大竹蹦『Meee——ga！
strings.en: Megaree: Meee-ga!
